PDF A Fast Voxel Traversal Algorithm for Ray Tracing
The traversal algorithm consists of two phases: initialization and incremental traversal. The initialization phase begins by identifying the voxel in which the ray origin, \(\vec{u}\), is found. If the ray origin is outside the grid, we find the point in which the ray enters the grid and take the adjacent voxel.
